build_summary_string: build a human-readable summary string from pre-computed covariate and weight diagnostics
build_diagnostics_dataframe: build a diagnostics DataFrame from pre-computed covariates, weights, and model data
coerce_failure_flag: coerce a raw adjustment failure value to a 0 or 1 integer
resolve_adjustment_failure_metadata: resolve adjustment failure metadata from a model dictionary into a failure flag and reason
concat_metric_val_var: append metric value and variable rows to an existing diagnostics DataFrame
